description: Window cleaning for Waters Edge in Rough Hollow. Lake adjacent homes with lake views, exterior glass $10 a window, pure water finish. Text for a quote.
intro: Waters Edge sits just back from the shoreline in Rough Hollow. You get lake views without full waterfront lots, and CleanzATX services these homes on a regular rotation with the neighboring lake sections.

paragraphs: Waters Edge is a smaller section of Rough Hollow for people who want the lake nearby without paying for a waterfront lot. Homes here are priced from about $2M to $2.9M. Rough Hollow's stucco and stone look carries through here, and the draw is being close to Lake Travis rather than sitting on the water.
The section is not gated, and it falls under the Rough Hollow HOA only, so there is no extra sub association to coordinate with. Parking a truck out front is usually easy.

sections.h2: What Waters Edge windows deal with
paragraphs: Lake spray reaches the first row less than the shoreline, but sprinkler overspray is the bigger enemy. Well kept lawns mean irrigation heads aim right at the lower glass, and that water is hard, so it leaves white rings that get worse each week it sits. We treat spotted panes at $10 each.

Porches and entries here also catch construction dust from the lots still opening in Rough Hollow, plus spider webs under the eaves. Interior hand cleaning at $15 a window combined with exterior takes care of the whole house.

We tend to book Waters Edge on the same day as The Point because the two are close, and a short drive between them helps both. Pole work handles the second story glass, and a screen clean at $5 each brings the screens back to life before spring pollen. Soft wash the stucco from $0.20 per sq ft, with a $400 minimum.
A 4,500 sq ft home is about $450 for exterior windows and runs around three hours outside. Inside adds roughly two more. A Triannual plan takes 15% off and includes the free yearly screen clean.

faq.q: Is Waters Edge on the waterfront?
faq.a: Not directly. The homes are lake adjacent with views, and prices sit below full waterfront sections. The glass still catches lake mist when the wind is right.

faq.q: What causes the white rings at the bottom of my windows?
faq.a: Sprinkler water. It is hard, and every cycle leaves minerals on the lowest panes. A hard water removal visit clears it, and adjusting your sprinkler heads away from the glass helps.

faq.q: Do you do the screens too?
faq.a: Yes. Screens are $5 each, full screens $10 and solar screens $15. Plan members on Triannual, Quarterly or Every 2 Months get a free screen cleaning each year.

faq.q: How long does a visit take?
faq.a: Exterior glass takes about 45 to 60 minutes per 1,000 sq ft. Inside adds about 30 minutes per 1,000 sq ft. We tell you the window of arrival when we schedule.

faq.q: Does the HOA care that you are working on my home?
faq.a: Only the Rough Hollow HOA applies in Waters Edge. We keep trucks off the lawn, clear of the neighbor's drive and tidy when we leave, so there is nothing to bother anyone.

faq.q: How do I get a price?
faq.a: Text us your address and rough square footage. We price at $10 per window, or about $0.10 per sq ft, and we usually answer within the hour during business hours.
